safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports a tingling sensation around the lips.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling around the lips; generated documentation describes tingling in the throat/depths and does not mention lip tingling.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Perioral tingling can be an early sign of systemic allergic reaction/anaphylaxis and helps characterize progression/severity of symptoms after a sting. Omitting it may reduce clarity of the red-flag symptom pattern, though escalation to emergency care was still advised.
